source.graph_values: approximate manual reads; use the source figures for authoritative values

interpretation.paper_reference_pressure: The tabulated 0.5 MPa is used only to form p_bar = p/p_s and W_bar = W/(p_s R_j^2); it is not imposed as a gauge-pressure feed.
interpretation.feed: The 4 mm project feed patch is retained as an ambient-pressure, fully flooded replenishment boundary. The paper shows rig port IP1 but does not disclose a 4 mm diameter or include a feed patch in its 60-node FEM domain.
interpretation.pressure_limit_basis: provisional local Babbitt-layer design ceiling supplied by the project supervisor; it is a design gate, not a numerical-convergence gate

figure6.quantity: maximum gauge pressure divided by 0.5 MPa

figure8.quantity: mid-plane circumferential gauge-pressure distribution in kPa
figure8.angle_reference: The source does not state enough information to map its plotted zero angle to the local +X/-Y convention. Circular phase alignment is reported separately and is not treated as predictive validation.
